content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

In the world of digital music sales, traditional platforms often impose steep fees that cut into your profits. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on each sale, which can be significant, especially for independent artists. By leveraging a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can minimize costs and maximize your earnings. Using NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, you can retain more of your income. This is particularly important for creators in countries where financial systems may be unstable or where conventional payment processors have limited access.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

To sell your music online using Bitcoin, you'll need a cohesive digital commerce stack. This includes a hosting solution, backend logic, and a payment processor. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free hosting for your storefront, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle order management. NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin automatically with minimal fees. This architecture not only ensures that you own your data but also provides a seamless experience for your customers, allowing for instant delivery of music files upon purchase.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators across regions where conventional payment methods are either restricted or inefficient. Whether you're a musician in Nigeria, a designer in Kenya, or a software developer in Venezuela, this approach empowers you to sell your products directly to your audience. You avoid the pitfalls of reliance on third-party platforms, ensuring that you have full control over your business and profits. This model is particularly advantageous for individuals looking to establish a sustainable income stream without the burden of high fees.
Retain more profits by reducing transaction fees to just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of your sovereign commerce stack include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for payment processing, and either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend functionality. Together, these components create a seamless purchasing experience. For example, when a customer pays with Bitcoin, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain, while your chosen hosting solution delivers the digital product automatically. This integration is crucial for maintaining efficiency and ensuring that your customers receive their products without delay.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by selecting a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle orders. Integrate NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin transactions. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you’ll get all the blueprints and templates needed to deploy your stack quickly. Follow the detailed documentation provided for each component to ensure everything is configured correctly. By following these steps, you’ll have a fully operational digital store ready to accept payments in Bitcoin.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a combination of free hosting services and automatic payment processors like NOWPayments. By building your own digital storefront, you retain more profits and avoid high transaction fees typically associated with platforms like Gumroad. This approach empowers you to control your sales and customer experience.
Own your data and infrastructure — no more reliance on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for solutions to sell ebooks or templates without traditional payment platforms, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need to set up your sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore the options available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to find the tools that will work best for you.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell music online without using PayPal?

You can sell music online by setting up your own digital storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments that supports Bitcoin. This allows you to process payments directly without the need for PayPal.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than many traditional platforms like Gumroad that charge around 10%. This means you retain more of your earnings per sale.
Can I automate product delivery for my music sales?
Yes, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of your music files as soon as a payment is confirmed. This ensures a smooth experience for your customers.
What is the advantage of using a sovereign commerce stack?
A sovereign commerce stack allows you full control over your online store. You own your data, avoid high platform fees, and eliminate the dependency on third-party services like PayPal or Stripe.
Is it possible to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Yes, by using a combination of free tools for hosting and backend processing along with NOWPayments for payment processing, you can sell digital downloads while minimizing platform fees.
